title: Characteristic-zero DVR completion is a regular map
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local discrete valuation ring (that is, a Noetherian local domain of Krull dimension one whose maximal ideal is principal, as characterized by [lem-sc-normal-dim1-dvr] and Stacks Tag 00PD), and assume that its fraction field $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ has characteristic zero. Let $A^\wedge$ be its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical map $A\to A^\wedge$ is a regular ring map in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]: it is flat by Stacks Tag 00MB, its generic fibre is $A^\wedge\otimes_A K=\operatorname{Frac}(A^\wedge)$ and is geometrically regular over $K$ because $K$ has characteristic zero, and its closed fibre is $A^\wedge/\mathfrak mA^\wedge\cong A/\mathfrak m$, a field. Equivalently, every fibre over a prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] geometrically regular algebra over the corresponding residue field.

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07PX (proposition-ubiquity-G-ring), proof of item (3), in the characteristic-zero DVR case: the completion is a DVR by More on Algebra Lemma Tag 0AP1 (lemma-completion-dvr), completion is flat by Algebra Lemma Tag 00MB (lemma-completion-flat), and the generic and closed fibres are geometrically regular; the Noetherian local-domain, dimension-one, principal-maximal-ideal characterization is Algebra Lemma Tag 00PD (lemma-characterize-dvr), and regular ring maps are Definition Tag 07BZ.

mathlib_searches.query: the canonical map from a Noetherian discrete valuation ring to its adic completion is a regular ring map with geometrically regular fibres
mathlib_searches.results: No G-ring or regular-ring-map declaration; AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian supplies only flatness and generic completion APIs
No matching declaration; no typeclass or predicate for regular ring maps with geometrically regular fibres
No G-ring, regular-ring-map, or geometrically-regular-fibre notion in Mathlib; AdicCompletion files contain flatness and local/completeness results only
